channel.title: LLM Machines Blog
channel.description: What changes in AI, what it enables, and what it takes to run it.

item.title: An operating plan for private AI: models, access, updates and recovery
item.description: After the first successful request, a private AI service needs named owners, access rules with quotas, an accepted update and rollback path, a recovery target and a clear boundary around integration.

item.title: How to design an inference benchmark that informs a purchase
item.description: A supplier benchmark can be real and still describe a different service. Define the workload, separate the first-token wait from generation, and agree the pass mark before you compare proposals.

item.title: What to check in an AI server beyond the chip headline
item.description: An AI server decision is not a chip decision. Check capacity, memory bandwidth, interconnect, precision support, power and availability against a named workload.

item.title: SGLang and prefix reuse: where an inference optimisation can help
item.description: Prefix reuse in SGLang: what a shared prompt prefix changes, which request patterns benefit, and the checks to run before you design a deployment around it.

item.title: From benchmark score to a private AI model shortlist
item.description: A benchmark score is a starting point. Five checks and a five-column worksheet turn a published result into a private AI model shortlist.

item.title: Before you buy private AI infrastructure, define what you need to control
item.description: A practical checklist for private AI buyers: deployment location, operating authority, model updates, application ownership, acceptance, and capacity.

item.title: How LLM Machines delivers managed private inference
item.description: How LLM Machines sizes, configures and maintains private inference, with workload testing, documented APIs and agreed operating responsibilities.

item.title: Introducing LLM Machines: the case for private inference
item.description: Meet LLM Machines: managed private inference for businesses that need control over model deployment, access, updates and ongoing operations.
